title: Heavy, sturdy, but what are all the symbols around the edges
text:
Heavy, sturdy, but what are all the symbols around the edges. This is the largest, most industrial apple corer I have ever seen! It is very heavy.
This could have been on a knight's table, ready to eviscerate any random food that happened to be served.

What bothers me greatly about this is that there are unidentified symbols all the way around this corer. It is divided into 12 sections, so I thought perhaps they went with a zodiac theme. But if yes, then who's? It doesn't match English symbols or Chinese symbols. What did I just let into my home?

There are gold symbols around the heavy, scored handles. Are they supposed to be lotus flowers? Who knows.

I find it disturbing to have unidentified symbolism all over this item, and not a peep from the manufacturer about it. It was not visible from the page from which I ordered this - it just looked like a black apple corer. I want to know what these symbols are, and what they stand for.
